rules.why: C2 asks what is still open before a build; an open question about an in-scope requirement blocks that release, and nobody writes that down. Only questions in state open count; a resolved one must not block.

then.flag: a requirement must trace to the value proposition it serves

rules.why: Failure F3: a requirement with no traceable reason gets built or dropped arbitrarily.

then.flag: a value proposition must have at least one success criterion that measures it

rules.why: Failure F4: success was never defined, so nobody could say when the product was done.

then.flag: a decision must cite the document that records it

rules.why: C4 and failure F2: a decision nobody can open is a rumour, and the graph would carry it as fact.

then.flag: something is both in scope of and excluded from the same release; supersede one of the two

rules.why: Failure F1: a builder agent cannot see the boundary if the graph says both; the older fact must be superseded, not left standing.

then.flag: a release marked shipped still has an open question blocking it

rules.why: C2 and B1 together: a release that shipped with a question still open means either the state or the question is stale, and someone should say which.
